notes: R214 deployment (run_state_policy.py). Gains, scale and payload match training / the R187 sysid setup. Limits are our safety stops, not training settings: wrist box = R214 sim rollout wrist range + margin; min wrist height 0.11 m above the table (training minimum 0.133 m); Speed stops: R214 moves up to ~1 m/s in sim (R220 p99 per-step motion 64-102 mm); lower them for cautious first runs. Cube ages: the bottom cube is static (2 s), a free carried cube must be re-detected within 0.5 s, a held cube is propagated with the wrist (latency_compensation) for up to 3 s. Start pose: a Reaching-family training start from the R217 banks (row 5692), S-W-E-, gripper 5 deg from straight down, hand centered over the trained cube region 0.30 m above the table; (44.6, -147.1, -107.3, -110.5, -131.6, 133.4) deg. The runner requires every joint within start_joint_tolerance_rad of it; move_to_start.py takes the arm there. Check clearance and the camera's view of the cubes on the real cell.
